paragraphs.text: Lhasa Gonggar International Airport (LXA/ZULS) serves as a key air gateway for Shannan (Gonggar), CN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 09/27: 4000 m (13123 ft) concrete, 10L/28R: 4000 m (13123 ft) concrete, 10R/28L: 4000 m (13123 ft) asphalt.

Ground transportation options connecting Lhasa Gonggar International Airport with central Shannan (Gonggar) include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from LXA should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Lhasa Gonggar International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Lhasa Gonggar International Airport is LXA and the ICAO code is ZULS.

faqs.q: Which city does LXA airport serve?
faqs.a: Lhasa Gonggar International Airport (LXA) serves Shannan (Gonggar), CN.
